Balsa Bridge

A balsa truss arch bridge that won my class's competition for the highest load-to-weight ratio.

I built a truss arch from balsa sticks and reinforced every joint with paper gussets so the load spread into the members instead of tearing the glue joints apart. On test day we loaded it from a hanger under the deck until it failed. It held the most weight for its own weight of any bridge in the class.
